subject: prevent Valkey crash when module is loaded twice (#415)
reason: The change is purely load-time: a static guard at the top of valkey-search's ValkeyModule_OnLoad that returns VALKEYMODULE_ERR instead of letting TrackCurrentAsMainThread's CHECK abort when the same libsearch.so is loaded a second time in one process. It alters no command reply, replication, persistence, or cluster behavior, and a single normal load never reaches it.
